**OnionHop v3.4.3**
 (v3.4.3)
A patch release fixing Tor bridges on macOS and lowering the macOS version requirement.
### Fixed
- **Tor bridges work again on macOS.** On macOS the Tor data folder lives under "~/Library/Application Support/", and the space in that path could stop Tor from launching the bridge helper (the managed proxy died immediately, so obfs4/snowflake/webtunnel bridges never connected).
